migration.description: Upgrade the host-local Connector journal with durable platform-to-adapter session/run identity correlation, revisioned cold-recovery generation rotation and a forward-readable format boundary.
migration.release_unit_description: Phase-one Connector local journal format v3.

public_api.scope: No public schema, command kind or transport change is introduced by this slice.

persistent_state.scope: The candidate reads v1 and v2, writes v3, and older binaries are not supported readers for v3 state.

durable_state.description: Append-only JSONL records for commands, ACK updates, host-owned session identities, observed app-server events and reconciliation outcomes.
durable_state.storage_implementation: Mode-0600 journal file inside a mode-0700 host-local directory.

source_compatibility_range.from_program_versions: Phase-one Connector journal formats v1 and v2.

rollout_observability.note: OpenJournal performs scanning, final-record repair and in-flight marking synchronously; the candidate exposes no runtime progress or pause hooks.

required_test_evidence: v1 records round-trip through the journal reader
v2 records round-trip through the journal reader
a v2 session_start record with command_id and request_digest is read, its exact resolved intent is returned, and a retry appends v3 without rewriting the v2 bytes
v3 identity records append without rewriting v1 or v2 history
v1 session-start records do not satisfy a new explicit creation identity
v2 session-start records persist command_id and payload digest
session aliases and run bindings preserve separate platform, adapter, thread, generation, command and native identities
cold recovery appends a generation revision while historical aliases, run bindings and observations remain replayable
equal identity records are idempotent and conflicting associations fail closed
native turn and operation indexes require the complete adapter, thread and generation tuple
observed events retain their raw payload and remain undispatchable until exact binding
pending and unknown run bindings do not materialize events
restart rebuilds exact indexes and rejects orphan bindings
unsupported journal format versions are rejected before state application
a torn final write is truncated safely
accepted and executing commands become unknown after restart
unknown outcomes require explicit reconciliation and are never replayed

a duplicate run.send after restart reconciles the exact persisted native ACK into the original generation binding before returning success, while missing native evidence remains unknown and no native command is replayed

a duplicate session.start after restart requires the unchanged command digest, the resolved session-start intent and the durable alias to agree before returning the same Session; missing or ambiguous facts remain unknown and never create a second native session
generation-qualified persisted RPC observations disambiguate reused JSON-RPC IDs without rewriting raw response events
approval claims from another session generation cannot apply a decision to the current pending request
approval resolution events retain the pending run identity when the app-server omits turnId
numeric and string JSON-RPC approval request IDs remain distinct
approval resolution and item-completion events must match the pending turn identity
journal startup and append paths enforce bounded 8 MiB record, event-count and file-size resources
minor.note: The candidate reads the immediately preceding v1/v2 journal state; v1 and v2 binaries are not supported readers for v3 records.

major.note: Direct major skips are rejected by format-version validation.
